text: Competitor / competitors / rival brands: product listings scraped from other brands' product detail pages. Reflects what other retailers are stocking and how those products are performing - rating velocity, stock status, price.
Self / our catalog / we / us / our own products: the styles we currently stock and sell. Reflects our own sell-through rate, stock status, and pricing - not competitor or social data.
Instagram / social media / influencers / posts: organic, user-generated social content, not sales data. Reflects cultural and social trend signal via engagement - likes, comments, follower reach.
